design: Post hoc comparisons on exposed development requests; the four-case width challenge was fixed before its inference under evaluation-v0.3. No independent or clinical validation.
pairing: Same exact request fingerprint and identical candidate IDs within each transport group; never pool formats or repeated hypotheses as independent cases. Lexical and provider-score top-k match the model max3 output cap; extractive_all is an explicitly uncapped candidate reference, not a matched output-budget arm.
provider_score_policy: Use score only within one known datasource per request, with every score finite and numeric; otherwise mark inapplicable. No imputation, cross-source scaling or interpretation as causal effect or prediction weight.
ablations: Compute no-literature and no-perturbation deterministic post-selection masks. Report observed retry count; no retry ablation effect if parent has no retry. No model or scientific ablation claim.
limitations: Selection agreement is not accuracy, scientific relevance or clinical prediction performance
Conditional on previously bounded candidates; does not compare end-to-end retrieval or full evidence coverage
Original and wire formats are separate diagnostics; all cases were exposed and action/modality variants are dependent
If every candidate set fits the three-ID selection cap, this design does not compel prioritization
Provider scores are descriptive source metrics, not comparable calibrated scientific support across datasources
Mask retention is a deterministic engineering result; model reruns, reviewer quality and causal feature effects remain unmeasured
Inherited source-inclusive proofs and sealed bytes are checked; raw originals are not rehashed in this diagnostic
Independent T6 truth, eligible clinical labels/censoring, qualified scoring and an executable matched Virtual Biotech arm remain required for Task 6 completion
